in_arabic.name: Bujud
in_arabic.long_meaning: Bujud هو اسم عربي إسلامي يحمل معنى عميقاً في الثقافة الإسلامية. Derived from the Arabic root 'bujd', meaning 'to become rich, to prosper'. This name is mentioned in a Hadith as a name given to a Companion of the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ. It is a name of spiritual and material prosperity, signifying a life of abundance and blessing.
